title: Floyd–Warshall Queries
statement:
Use Floyd–Warshall to answer all-pairs shortest-path queries in a directed graph. Negative weights are allowed and the graph has no negative cycle.

Input
n m q, then m directed edges u v w, then q pairs u v. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed.

Output
For each pair print its shortest distance or NONE if unreachable.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 450, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Weights have absolute value at most 10⁹.
